title: Clinical Distance
style: sophisti-pop, female lead vocals, detached clinical delivery, synthetic sounds, acoustic guitars, synth bass, drum machine, mid-tempo, polished production
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Instrumental: synthetic textures blended with delicate acoustic guitar picking]

[Verse 1]
Mid-2023, the basis was clear
Thomas spoke of you, though I was not near
Perceptive, self-possessed, in a patterned role
Sugar-dependent, under Gabi's control
An uneasy look at the age asymmetry
Your developmental task is to break free

[Chorus]
But it's adaptive and chosen, a carefully managed scene
Keeping the performance separate from what you mean
A clinical distance in the way you operate
An ego-syntonic role you hold without debate

[Verse 2]
Bogotá in the spring, March and April nights
Open and funny in the warm social lights
Then the warmth cooled down, aligned with her view
You suspect what we know, and the shadow grew
Yet your emotional intelligence is high
Underneath the shield and the guarded eye

[Chorus]
But it's adaptive and chosen, a carefully managed scene
Keeping the performance separate from what you mean
A clinical distance in the way you operate
An ego-syntonic role you hold without debate

[Bridge]
July twenty-five, the report is written down
Instrumental choices in a quiet town
Attachment to her is the one authentic chord
In a presentation where nothing is ignored
Now twenty-six arrives, the degree is complete
The anchor has shifted on a different street

[Guitar Solo]
[Instrumental: acoustic guitar solo over sleek synth bass and clinical drum machine]

[Outro]
Your dependence lessens, the distance starts to grow
Let's see how you navigate the things you slowly know
[Fade Out]
